common_initial_spec: Use case: stylized-concept. Production UI avatar, original unofficial brand-inspired chibi girl. Square true transparent PNG. Single front-facing head-and-shoulders portrait centered within middle 78% of canvas, 11% clear alpha safety margin each side. Large face readable at 32/48/64px. Cute polished 2D anime illustration, crisp dark navy outlines, broad clean color areas, subtle cel shading, friendly competent expression. No text, letters, watermark, frame, background, checkerboard, weapons, glow or ground shadow. Hair, horns and shoulders fully inside canvas.
padding_edit_spec: Edit target: supplied UI portrait. Preserve character, facial features, colors, pose, illustration style. Change only composition: scale the ENTIRE portrait down to occupy 65% of square canvas height and at most 65% width, centered. Genuine completely transparent padding of AT LEAST 17% on EVERY side, including below shoulders and above hair. Remove every stray isolated colored speck outside subject. All outermost alpha pixels strictly within central 65%. Do not crop any part of portrait. No new details, no text, no background, no checkerboard. Padded small UI avatar.
